zoe: Quick heads-up 1: starting a short focused recert for orphaned KMS grants + service-account bindings that only show up in nightly cron jobs. Scope: owners, tfstate vs ownership-registry diffs, and cross-project principals. Evidence tickets only, no auto-revoke.
rav: Thanks. Two Qs: 1) Do we treat terraform-managed bindings as auto-owned by infra teams? 2) How do we avoid breaking scheduled batches?
zoe: 1) we'll diff tfstate and tag bindings as infra-tracked vs infra-untracked; infra-tracked go to infra-owner email, infra-untracked go to principal email + access-cert-steward cc. 2) We tag SAs with cron-svc and set a "do-not-revoke" flag so pipeline never sets revoke=true for cron-svc items.
infra-bot: recert-scan job rc-20261101-01 kicked off at 2026-11-01T21:00:03Z. Scanning IAM, KMS grants, and SA usage. Will post summary when collection completes.
elena: Quick log check you can run while we wait (gcloud):
```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_key" AND protoPayload.methodName:"Decrypt"' --limit=100 --freshness=90d --format='value(protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, timestamp, resource.labels.key_name)'
```
Use that to mark keys with recent decrypts as low-priority for removal.
ops-oncall: FYI owner outreach emails have caused noisy pages in the past when aliases are oncall. Please add header X-Notify-Policy:quiet for known oncall aliases and rate-limit notifications to 45/hr. Also include a 1-click "I own this" ack in tickets to reduce followups.
infra-bot: collection finished at 2026-11-01T21:03:27Z 1,420 total bindings scanned, 63 KMS grants flagged cross-project, 34 SAs only referenced by nightly cron jobs, 48 infra-untracked bindings. Creating 64 owner-evidence tickets.
rav: I'll take the top-10 cross-project KMS grants and ping partner-eng before tickets go out.
elena: I'll add a small snippet to the runbook with an HSM-check: skip keys with protection_level != "SOFTWARE" and mark rotation_recent keys as requires-manual-review.
zoe: Plan recap: 1) tickets created (evidence only) 2) 72h response window 3) if ownerless escalate to infra-oncall for manual remediation 4) final manual revoke only by oncall with runbook checklist. Volunteers: @rav partner outreach, @elena runbook updates. Thanks. :thumbsup:
